brief.goal: 解析默认备用网页 site_id/site_name 与 optimized_goal 橙子落地页站点信息联动合同，验证目标账户可见性，生成 fresh runtime job，并在全通过后预置单次 execution grant。

forbidden_actions: legacy project runtime import or shell call
saving token, Cookie, full URL, raw payload, or raw response to project files/logs/API/frontend
using web search for OceanEngine docs instead of local official knowledge docs
constructing or guessing landing page URLs from screenshots, site_id, legacy runtime, or external SDK notes
acceptance: default backup landing page optimized_goal linkage resolved or blocked with explicit reason: blocked_backend_landing_linkage_contract_not_materialized
target account visibility/readback or backend linkage verified before active
fresh runtime job created only after landing page gate passes
fresh job node 1-5 ready and payload contract/preflight passed
execution grant scoped to fresh job only if all gates pass
historical failed job has no new action
